# @dxtmisha/zip

> High-performance utility library for creating and managing ZIP archives in browser and Node.js environments.

Built on top of `fflate`, `@dxtmisha/zip` provides a simple object-oriented API for compressing files, managing in-memory archives, and triggering native browser downloads.

## Key Classes & Methods

- [Zip](src/classes/Zip.ts): Main class managing archive lifecycle.
  - `addFile(name, data, options)`: Add text string, Uint8Array, or Blob to the archive.
  - `removeFile(name)`: Remove a file from the archive.
  - `is()`: Check if the archive contains any files.
  - `get()`: Generate and return the compressed `Uint8Array` buffer.
  - `save(name?)`: Trigger native browser file download via Blob and temporary object URL.
